title: Anonymous /rest/verify/captcha creates unbounded HttpSession-retained Captcha objects
source: permitAll verification endpoint path variable type=caption
driver: number of fresh sessions created by requests that omit or vary the session cookie
retention: servlet HttpSession lifetime; Captcha object includes a BufferedImage and is not removed on generation
bound: fixed session attribute key only bounds one session; no per-IP, global session-count, rate, or endpoint enable check was found; citrus.verify.enable=false only gates login validation
impact: static evidence for default anonymous heap retention; dynamic default-deployment service-unavailable threshold not measured
dynamic_probe: loop GET /rest/verify/captcha with no Cookie against default compose backend/front; observe active session count, heap, GC, response latency and restart/OOM under a bounded heap
